column1: # Nintendo Switch Sports Resort (Switch 2, update v65536). Work in progress: boots to its title, menus, golf and tennis on the Mac with the PRs its note lists.
# Nintendo EPD's engine (sead / agl / gsys, Phive, Havok), SDK 22 (NVN 22.2.10), NVN2; modules main + subsdk0 + sdk. Packed from a dump folder by scripts/build_ipa_from_nsp.py.
# The values below are the survey's (dm/games/profile_guess.py) and the NSP script's heap check, unchanged after play.
# not loaded, main takes nothing from them the host does not supply: subsdk1 (nn::camera), subsdk2 (C / libc), subsdk3 (C / libc), subsdk4 (other C++)
# the sdk is built for the Switch 2 (spec: Ounce): its 9 GB pool
# the NPDM declares 32 MB of system resource
# the game asked for a 7.47 GB heap
# the game calls nvnDeviceSetDepthMode with near = 0 in the check boot: the pipeline bases made before it runs are made for that mode
# heap check: 2026-11-09, the heap request did not fit, then heap 7.47 GB; set mem_reserve, depth_mode
